assumptions: The supplied artifact SHA-256 and the per-file digests in SOURCE-MANIFEST.json could not be recomputed because the only permitted mechanism is a read-only file reader with no hashing or shell capability; instead, digest values were checked for textual consistency across SOURCE-MANIFEST.json, convergence-replan-record.json, drift-lock.json, and execution-contract.json openspec.baseline_sha256 (all match), and the artifact is treated as the coordinator-pinned unchanged digest.

execution-contract.json (4664 lines) and tasks.md (1371 lines) were verified by structured sampling: every top-level section was read, ~40 checks across all series (V_A/V_C/V_D/V_E/V_INFRA/V_P1_6/V_P1_2/V_I02/V_RW/V_SAME_RUN/V_POST_DELIVERY/V_N) plus the full acceptance_aggregation tail covering all 104 scenarios were inspected; the unread remainder is uniformly structured check/task entries of the same schema observed at multiple offsets.

task-dag.json was read in full across four reads covering every task node's depends_on list, the waves array, and trailer fields; topological consistency of all 39 nodes against the 39 single-node waves was manually checked.

Existing user authorization for convergence implementation is taken as recorded in the artifact (convergence-replan-record.json authorization field, task-dag.json execution_scope=USER_AUTHORIZED_CONVERGENCE_EXECUTION_NEW_PROFILE_NOT_ACCEPTED, ADR-0020 status line); this review does not independently re-derive that user instruction.

findings.claim: Verification-runner profile token is inconsistent within the frozen contract: the 12 new convergence checks V_N01-V_N12 use '--profile comet-managed-v2' while the original-scenario journey checks and the three full-journey checks use '--profile managed-pilot', and verification-case-plan.json intended_command strings are uniformly 'managed-pilot'.
findings.evidence: execution-contract.json V_N01 command (line 3749) 'node tools/verify/delivery-journey.mjs --scenario N01 --profile comet-managed-v2 ...' (same token in V_N04 line 3833, V_N05 3861, V_N12 4051); V_A01 command (line 154), V_SAME_RUN_DELIVERY (line 3681), V_RW_REAL_COMET_RECOVERY (line 3613), V_POST_DELIVERY_PERMISSIONS (line 3722) all use '--profile managed-pilot'; verification-case-plan.json A01 intended_command (line 13) and the N-case entries (lines 2786-2995, which carry no intended_command) sit under case statuses CURRENT_PROFILE_RETEST_REQUIRED. commands_status (execution-contract.json line 4070) declares these are planned public interfaces, not executable evidence, limiting impact to drift risk at VERIFY time.
findings.recommendation: During P3_1 observer qualification and before VERIFY, converge on one current-profile token (or register an explicit alias mapping from managed-pilot to comet-managed-v2) so the 92 retained original-scenario commands do not silently target a retired profile; P1_6 owns foundation/profiles/comet-managed.json as profile_source_target per flow_convergence.

findings.claim: verification-case-plan.json journey_definitions still carry status 'IMPLEMENTED' with 2026-10-23 execution text claiming 'recipe check PASS + real journey execution PASS', which contradicts the governing execution contract's PLANNED_REPAIR_NOT_EXECUTED for the same three checks and could be misread post-reset as current passes.
findings.evidence: verification-case-plan.json lines 2998-3023: same-run-delivery/real-comet-recovery/post-delivery-permissions all status IMPLEMENTED, executed_at 2026-10-23T07:48:16Z, execution text 'VERIFY @ 0dcfec1: recipe check PASS + 真实旅程执行 PASS'; execution-contract.json V_SAME_RUN_DELIVERY (3684-3698), V_RW_REAL_COMET_RECOVERY (3615-3632), V_POST_DELIVERY_PERMISSIONS (3724-3740) all implementation_status PLANNED_REPAIR_NOT_EXECUTED with historical_results_may_close=false and execution_owner VERIFY; file-level status CURRENT_PROFILE_NOT_VERIFIED (line 3) and convergence_revision 2026-10-24-comet-convergence (line 3024) supersede the stale labels.
findings.recommendation: Annotate the three journey_definitions entries as historical pre-convergence evidence superseded by the 2026-10-24 baseline (or set status to HISTORICAL_SUPERSEDED) during P3_2/P3_3/P4_8 recipe work so implementers cannot misread them as current acceptance.

findings.claim: Original-scenario checks define implementedBy but generally omit an explicit execution_owner field; final execution ownership is nonetheless unambiguous because the contract assigns the full 130-check re-execution to VERIFY.
findings.evidence: execution-contract.json V_A01-V_D08, V_C04-V_C08 samples (e.g., lines 171-174, 368-374) have implementedBy but no execution_owner, while V_N01 (line 3754), V_N04 (3838) and all three journey checks (3630, 3696, 3737) carry execution_owner: VERIFY; final_verification_task=VERIFY (line 3) and journey_execution.owner=VERIFY (line 4175) make final ownership singular.
findings.recommendation: When P3_1 regenerates the check table for the new baseline, backfill execution_owner=VERIFY on all checks so machine consumers cannot infer split ownership from field absence.

findings.claim: Already-started execution (18 legacy entries moved to a recoverable backup, P1_2 anti-reintroduction repair in an isolated worktree) is correctly fenced as an authorized safety substep under prior retirement policy, not as profile acceptance, and destructive/global actions are explicitly out of scope.
findings.evidence: convergence-replan-record.json notes[1-2] ('Current-profile acceptance is0; actual18-entry retirement is a completed safety substep'; 'new business profile remains gated'); execution-contract.json flow_convergence.migration_safety_work (line 4662); runtime.capability_evidence explicitly states migration worktree isolation is not proof of product Runner security (lines 13-16); HANDOFF.md 当前安全子步 section (P1_2 limited to tools/adapters/claude-code.sh, test/foundation-distribution.test.js, report) and cleanup-scope bullets (不清空真实知识/数据库，不卸载全局/其它项目技能，不销毁旧Run或唯一工作区); ADR-0020 decision 1 requiring recoverable backups and excluding user-global assets.
findings.recommendation: None required for this gate; keep recording such substeps in convergence-replan-record.json notes so they remain visibly outside acceptance accounting.

summary: Round-1 re-ballot after visibility was resolved via the exact file index: I read all 17 listed files (bounded pages for the large JSON contracts) and can now score on evidence, superseding my round-0 abstention which was purely an artifact-readability failure. The artifact is a coherent, internally consistent architecture and execution contract for converging the legacy command/knowledge flows onto the frozen Comet single-controller profile, and it matches the gated decision exactly: implementation authorization only, with runtime acceptance, business-profile enablement, and all external writes/publication still gated. Independently verified: task-dag.json has 39 nodes / 69 work packages, all depends_on edges point backward within the 39 single-node waves, and VERIFY is the sole sink depending on all 38 other nodes; counts 92 original + 12 new = 104 scenarios and 108 retained + 10 repair + 12 new = 130 required checks are consistent across SOURCE-MANIFEST, replan record, handoff, contract, and commands_status; the acceptance_aggregation maps all 104 scenarios (A01-N12) to concrete check IDs; spec.md N01-N12 oracles textually match the V_N01-V_N12 expected fields; bindings.json covers N01-N12. Boundary design is strong and frozen: Comet sole Run/state/dispatch/recovery owner with no second currentPhase, TeamAI distribute-only, pure-evaluate Gate, execute-only Runner/adapter, method skills without dispatch authority, Kp blocking all archive entries and Kt blocking completion, monitor/supervisor outside business authority (drift-lock frozen interfaces lines 115-155, global constraints 157-167, controller_override/closeout_override lines 4072-4073). Security posture for this stage is sound: trusted identity from launcher records not role strings (V_RW_TRUSTED_REVIEW, observer_contract pass_requirements), real OS/container role isolation as a negative gate (V_RW_RUNNER_BUILD, RoleBoundary.v1), secrets only as purpose-bound SecretRef.v1, fail-closed disclosure-intersection publication authorization with unknown≠public (U02/U06, V_U04-U06), quarantine/fence-on-restore (Restore.v1), R10 sole-workspace retention, no production/remote writes without registered grants, credentials_included=false. Fail-closed reliability semantics (UNVERIFIED nonzero, no skip-to-PASS, historical_results_may_close=false everywhere, monotonic invalidation with no byte-restore revival) are consistently expressed. Two non-blocking drift risks remain and are owned by existing DAG tasks: the managed-pilot vs comet-managed-v2 profile token split (R2-001) and the stale pre-convergence IMPLEMENTED/PASS journey_definitions labels (R2-002), both explicitly flagged as planned-not-executed interfaces by the governing contract. I would authorize implementing the frozen converged profile under the recorded existing authorization with the artifact's own verification gates left intact.
